name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA)
objective: Extract two-way confidentiality terms, active windows, and governing laws.

attributes.name: Agreement Title
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the title/heading of the agreement (e.g. 'Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement').

attributes.name: Disclosing Party A
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the full legal name of the first party.

attributes.name: Disclosing Party B
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the full legal name of the second party.

attributes.name: Effective Date
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the date the agreement becomes effective.

attributes.name: Term / Duration
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the duration the agreement remains in force (e.g. '2 years').

attributes.name: Confidentiality Period
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract how long confidentiality obligations survive after termination.

attributes.name: Definition of Confidential Information
attributes.extractionPrompt: Summarise what the agreement defines as Confidential Information.

attributes.name: Permitted Use
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the permitted purpose for which confidential information may be used.

attributes.name: Governing Law
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the governing law / jurisdiction clause.

attributes.name: Mutual or One-Way
attributes.extractionPrompt: Classify whether obligations are mutual (two-way) or one-way.

attributes.name: Signatory Names
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the names and titles of all signatories.

attributes.name: Signature Date
attributes.extractionPrompt: Extract the date(s) the agreement was signed.
